title: Monitor intake finds a Reference without listing every Reference
description: ReferenceIntake calls list_records('Reference') for each delivery. About 1,100 arXiv papers a day against about 9,000 References will not hold. Check for an existing index first; otherwise propose one. Found 2026-11-03, not started.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Same whole-table read on the editor intake path: intake_references in src/papyrus_content/reference_intake.py calls client.list_records('Reference') on every intakePendingReferences request (every create-from-catalog source and every Newsroom paste) before find_or_create_source_reference. Found 2026-11-13 while fixing the create-from-catalog output (PR #1494); the fix there left it alone. One index lookup by canonical source URL per corpus would serve both paths.
